name: @stipend-mcp/cli
stderr:
unknown command: stdio

stipend-mcp <command> [options]

Commands:
  dev      Boot the full local stack (proxy + API + mock Stripe + dev
           resolver).

           --upstream <cmd> [args...]   The upstream MCP server to proxy
                                        in front of. Required. Spawns a
                                        child process and pipes stdio.
                                        Example:
                                          --upstream npx @upstream/server
           --proxy-port <port>          Agent-facing port. Default 7071.
           --api-port <port>            Host-facing API port. Default 7070.
           --emulator                   Use Firestore on the local
                                        emulator instead of in-memory
                                        stores. Needs FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST
                                        (refuses to start without it);
                                        auto-detected when it is set.
           --quiet                      Suppress info/warn lines; errors
                                        still print.

  keygen   Generate an Ed25519 signing keypair (PEM).

           --key-id <id>                Identifier embedded in every
                                        receipt signed with this key.
                                        Default: stipend-<YYYY-MM-DD>.
           --out <path>                 Write to file (mode 600) instead
                                        of stdout.

  repair   One-off data repairs after upgrading from 0.1.0-alpha.2.
           Dry run unless --apply. See `stipend-mcp repair --help`.

  --version, -v                          Print version.
  --help, -h                             Print this help.

Examples:
  stipend-mcp dev --upstream npx @upstream/mcp-server
  stipend-mcp keygen --key-id stipend-prod-2026 --out ./signing.pem
  stipend-mcp repair payment-index --project my-project --apply
